title: Provide supported recovery when a deleted host session leaves an unexpired work claim
outcome: Provide supported recovery when a deleted host session leaves an unexpired work claim
acceptance: A replacement executor can resolve an orphaned unexpired claim through an explicitly authorized, audited supported path without impersonating its former holder, editing SQLite, or waiting for its original TTL.
Recovery preserves work/run evidence, advances the claim fence, and rejects stale operations from the previous holder; ordinary competing live sessions cannot steal claims.
Document the host-session deletion and recovery boundary, including behavior when deletion or termination cannot be verified.
